source_title: En Que Moneda Obtendre Mi Comision
snippet_primary: "En caso de que tu venta no cumpla ninguna de las reglas mencionadas anteriormente, la comisión será en dólares (USD)."
subject_exact: Hotmart commission currency help center (help.hotmart.com/es, as of April 2026) states that if a sale does not meet any of the specific currency rules, the commission is paid in US dollars (USD) by default
local_qualifiers: Hotmart help (as of Apr 2026): default commission currency is USD when no specific rule applies
parser_notes: help.hotmart.com (as of Apr 2026). Spanish. Default commission: USD if no currency rule applies. Implies BRL/EUR/GBP rules exist for specific conditions.
